overview: Released from prison, Ángela tries to regain the respect of her daughter, who loves lucha libre wrestling, by entering the ring as a mysterious persona.
title: Contra las cuerdas

overview: Johnny is a musician who moves to a house in the woods in order to work on his music. Once he arrives, however, he discovers that this is not just any house! His solitude is subsequently disturbed by two magical creatures called Sprites. The Sprites, Ginger and Basil, then learn life lessons from Johnny (in the form of a musical number). Occasionally, Johnny's cranky neighbor, Mrs. Moldystew, peeks across the fence to chastise him for being noisy!
title: Johnny and the Sprites

overview: Hosted by a rotating cast of comedy greats, The Daily Show remains the go-to source for provocative satire, insightful interviews and an award-winning team of correspondents and contributors.
title: The Daily Show

overview: Leverage is a slick and crafty drama following a team of expert thieves that take down corrupt corporations in elaborate high-tech schemes. Insurance investigator Nate Ford exposed scams and recovered stolen items worth millions. But his life hit the skids when his insurance company allowed his ailing 8-year-old son to die. Years later, Nate gets even as the leader of a specialized team of thieves, computer experts and con artists that right corporate and governmental injustices against honest citizens. To expose corruption, Nate will do wrong for all the right reasons –– he will provide Leverage.
title: Leverage

overview: In this anthology series, tales of horror and science fiction are filmed live and presented to the viewing audience. Along with timeless tales of terror like Frankenstein and 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea, stories of suspense with twist endings are presented.
title: Tales of Tomorrow

overview: Wu Lin, a modern freelance writer, helps her friend, Xu Xixi, to finish her novel and becomes the character that she hates the most in the book, Wu Yuling, Her Ladyship of Donglin City. Different from the character, Wu Lin dislikes all the palace and harem intrigue, and how women please men for power. On one hand, she wants to go back to the reality, and at the same time, she's changing the plot, but she was jeopardised by Song Wei's brother, Song Yi. Eventually, she has made a daring decision...
title: The Castellan Belongs to Me

overview: One is the a hardworking and cold boss, the other is a talkative and strong female soldier. These two people who seem to be from two separate worlds, but come together by mistake. They start their well-matched love story.
title: Knight of the Rose

overview: Adapted from the novel "Shao Nian Ge Xing" (少年歌行) by Zhou Mu Nan (周木楠). Aspiring young hero Lei Wu Jie was on his way to the great Xue Yue City when he mistakenly strayed into the Fallen Snow Villa. His first heroic deed does not go as planned since he ended up owing the owner Xiao Se a debt for the damages to his place. Left with no choice, Lei Wu Jie takes Xiao Se along and on their journey, they meet Tang Lian who is a disciple of the Tang sect. Together, the group of youths embark on an adventure.
title: The Blood of Youth

overview: A group of courtesans attempts to escape the grasp of a notorious kingpin - but political corruption and blood ties make freedom a near-impossible goal. The women of Shanty Town will do whatever it takes to gain their freedom.
title: Shanty Town

overview: The story follows two middle school youth, Lin Xi and Ji Jun Xing, as they tell a sweet love story between two people who established empathy as they go through their youth together. Lin Xi is a girl who is full of strength and vitality, has a high IQ, and loves horror movies. When someone is bullied, she becomes a hardcore heroine and easily solves various problems. Meanwhile, Ji Jun Xing is a cold, straightforward and introverted man who is an all-around student of computer software programming. He is Lin Xi's classmate and friend. He may look cold on the outside, but in fact, he is a warm man who is not good at showing emotion. Adapted from the web novel "Time Is Just Right With Him" (时光与他恰是正好) by Jiang Mu Tong (蒋牧童)
title: Time and Him Are Just Right

overview: A story about a woman, a woman who envies her, and a man who want to take a revenge.
title: Glamorous Temptation

overview: Chat show presented by Nick Hancock in which celebrities recall their showbusiness careers with the help of archive clips.
title: You Only Live Once

overview: From finding birth parents to proving inheritance to uncovering their conception through fertility fraud, expert genealogist Shelbi Titus-Walker uses DNA technology to provide answers to mysteries to which people are desperately searching.
title: My DNA Mystery

overview: Based on real facts, Abandonados recalls the unprecedented alliance between the Portuguese, Timorese and Australians uniting against a common enemy that did not hesitate to commit the greatest atrocities against the local populations and against all those who opposed him. The series narrates the dramatic situation in which many of these men and women were left, forgotten and abandoned in Timor, and the persistent struggle of a soldier - Lieutenant Pires, who, against all obstacles and difficulties, created by the Salazar government itself, did everything to save his companions, until his final sacrifice. This series shows us the tortuous paths of politics and the interests of states overcoming individual interests, with all the injustice and inhumanity that this often entails, giving Abandonados a universal meaning.
title: Abandonados

overview: Lycée Toulouse-Lautrec tells the story of a high school like no other. A high school that welcomes students with disabilities, such as Marie-Antoinette, a bubbly quadriplegic, or Charlie, suffering from a brain tumor. But also valid students, like Victoire, a young teenager forced to join this extraordinary place to follow her brother and who, although initially refractory, will gradually overcome her prejudices. There she will discover friendship, love, solidarity but also humor, courage and strength of all her classmates, as well as the devotion and altruism of parents and teachers.
title: Lycée Toulouse-Lautrec

overview: The famous singer, People's Artist of Russia Nikolai lives his stellar life, filled with interviews, love from fans and concerts. Tired of touring flights, one day Nikolai realizes that the world of glamor and luxury that surrounds him does not bring him joy at all. It seems to Nikolai that something went wrong in his life, he mentally returns to his childhood dreams. As a child, he wanted to become a pilot and felt boundless freedom. In life there is always a place for a miracle. Little pilot Kolya received a distress signal from the nostalgic Nikolai and landed to meet him...
title: Поворот наоборот

overview: Return Man is a private detective company that claims a 100% successful return rate for owners seeking their lost belongings. Of course, this service comes with a hefty fee. When Pribpraw's beloved cat gets stolen by her ex-boyfriend, she hires...
title: Return Man

overview: The Julekalender is a Christmas story about three "nisser" who have to go from the North Pole and back to the cave in the Norwegian province of Trøndelag to find the life melody of the head nisse who is about to die. However they have to watch out for the evil "Nåså", who during the series comes to live with a potato farmer nearby. The series is based on funny lines containing dialect or a mix between Norwegian and English. The lines are repeated in episode after episode, and if a good line occurs, one of the nisses will say "Hey, that's a good vending (phrase). Maybe we can use that in another episode!" The show is a copy from the danish "The Julekalender" (1991).
title: The Julekalender

overview: The supernatural girl Ye Luo accidentally bound a contract with the ninth lord Cang Lan Ye, possessing the ability to forcibly summon the ninth lord, and discovered that this powerful and mysterious ninth lord actually has two forms: humanoid and half-demon. Ye Luo and Cang Lan Ye fought their wits and courage around the contract, and gradually got to know and fell in love with each other in the process of forming an alliance. However, Cang Lan Ye decided to stay away from Ye Luo in order to prevent the half-demon force from getting out of control due to the contract, suppressing the out-of-control force. The relationship between the two also ushered in a new crisis.
title: Let's Get Married, My Lord

overview: The story of a little fairy maiden Qiao Chuchu who was entrusted by the God of Matchmaking to help Li Wuyou, who has the blood of the monster clan, to facilitate marriage, the story of trying to find happiness.
title: Demon Emperor's Little Matchmaker

overview: Adapted from the web novel "Xi Shi Gui" (喜时归) by Yue Xia Wu Mei Ren (月下无美人). Royal Princess Li Yanchu rescued Han Shu from the execution ground and trained him in order to cultivate him as the lackey of the imperial court for the emperor, also her younger brother. When she was dying of illness, she designed her own death so that Han Shu could faithfully assist Li Jie. Three years later, Li Yanchu was reborn on Xie Yugui's body, and found out that she was seriously ill because of being poisoned, so she started to investigate, but got entangled again with Han Shu whose personality changed totally.
title: Revenge of Royal Princess

overview: An audience full of previous contestants who had heart-wrenching losses get a second chance to win big; prizes include a trip to a private island in Belize, a 14-day cruise to Antarctica, a sailboat, new car, cash prizes and a home theater set.
title: The Price is Right at Night

overview: The two-part television film, Das Weisse Haus am Rhein is based on true events and describes how the family around Fritz Dreesen (Benjamin Sadler) ran a highly renowned hotel in Bad Godesberg after the First World War. Guests such as Marlene Dietrich, Charlie Chaplin and Gustav Stresemann stayed here, but also a man named Adolf Hitler who was registered as a "stateless writer". Fritz and Maria Dreesen's (Katharina Schüttler) hotel experienced the Golden Twenties as well as the National Socialist era - including all the dramatic turns in politics and society.
title: Das Weisse Haus am Rhein

overview: A group of bright Sarah Lawrence College students fall under the dark influence of a friend's father, Larry Ray. With unprecedented access to the survivors who lived with Ray, the film follows the cult from its origins through its still-unfolding aftermath.
title: Stolen Youth: Inside the Cult at Sarah Lawrence

overview: The cultural phenomenon and hit musical series, "Glee," catapulted a cast of relative unknowns into international superstardom and literally rocked pop culture. But, the show that sparked a new era of acceptance was also saddled with extreme devastation on the inside. Endless scandals, tabloid gossip and fatal tragedies plagued the rising stars on what was supposed to be the most joyful show on television. Now, ID pulls back the curtain on "Glee" to explore the harsh reality of fame with the three-part limited series, The Price of Glee.
title: The Price of Glee

overview: From the rom-com-worthy Playboy Club romance that comes to a screeching, fatal halt, to the centerfold girl who gets tangled up with a serial killer – The Playboy Murders expose the pitfalls of fame for those that appear in their storied pages. Equal parts nostalgic and shocking, this anthology brings compelling murder investigations to life, while also exploring cultural attitudes about sex, love, and fame.
title: The Playboy Murders

overview: Death by Fame goes behind the scenes to uncover the sinister side of fame and reveal the shocking true stories behind the rise, fall and murder of some of Hollywood's most promising stars.
title: Death by Fame

overview: The story of Lee Segye who can see one minute into the future and Ha Nabi who caught his eye.
title: Life After One Minute

overview: Freeman follows a family, which moves to a small, picturesque town in Georgia after acquiring a lucrative inheritance, including the mysterious house known as Freeman Manor. It's soon discovered that there are mysteries and darkness hidden within the walls, and the town at large, that go back generations.
title: Freeman

overview: Nashi 30 (Our 30 Years) is a historic films project dedicated to the 30th anniversary of Ukraine's independence.
title: Наші 30

overview: A story about a 50-year-old man with a dream to make his fellow villagers wealthy. Having lived in the city for a long time, Liu Laogen (Zhao Benshan) returns to his hometown to engage his efforts in tourism and uses folk art to attract an audience.
title: Liu Lao Gen

overview: Within the past decade, dozens of young Indigenous women and girls from the Crow and Northern Cheyenne Nations have disappeared from Montana's Big Horn County and its surrounding areas. Grieving Native families who fear the worst press local law enforcement for answers, but their pleas are most often met with silence or indifference. Arrests in these cases are rare, and convictions are virtually nonexistent. Elsewhere in America, similar stories of disappearances and death shock communities and become nationwide news, but when they occur on Native land, a circle of bereft family members, friends, and activists are left to fight for justice on their own. Murder in Big Horn intimately embeds with these families and this community in an effort to shine a light on the unanswered mysteries of this land.
title: Murder in Big Horn

overview: The policeman Moaz Ibrahim is forced to become an informant for the east end's most dangerous gang environment, Enemiez.
title: Blodsbrødre

overview: Kevin, nicknamed Space, and buddy Hank decide to abandon the routine life to drive across the country. Whatever situation they encounter they adapt and their plans are defined by no rules, no map, just go.
title: Going to California

overview: Kate Brasher follows a young single mother raising two high school-age boys in Los Angeles while juggling multiple minimum-wage jobs. Masterson's character is stiffed on a paycheck and subsequently referred to a local nonprofit advocacy center for help in making her employer pay up. Intrigued by the agency's cases, she winds up with a job as a case worker for them.
title: Kate Brasher

overview: Three best friend, Tamara, Duffy and Eleonora, study together in a Tel Aviv school. They have been friends since childhood, and gave each other a pledge that their relations will be inviolable. Parents opposite sex, different hobbies - all this is unable to sow discord between the girls. Together, they solve their problems, share with each other the joys and sorrows, and are not even aware that their friendship will soon come to an end. Just one summer vacation - and here relations become strained, disputes, quarrels and misunderstandings.
title: יומני החופש הגדול

overview: The 1978 kidnapping and murder of Aldo Moro by the Red Brigades as seen by an outsider perspective, that of his family and political allies.
title: Esterno notte

overview: A select group of friends follow their passions in the West Hollywood community, made up of some of the most influential and successful LGBTQ celebrities and businessmen.
title: The Real Friends of WeHo

overview: Based on the British series This Life, First Years takes a humorous, intimate look at the lives of five first-year law graduates as they struggle to get their careers off the ground in San Francisco. They are handed all of the grunt work and receive none of the glory. To help pay off their student loans, four of them save money by sharing a fixer-upper house together in the Haight-Ashbury district. Anna Weller is a fearless, straight-forward career woman who lives on her own; Warren Harrison is the most stable of the group, but a bit of an outsider; Riley Kessler is someone who is simply normal and loves her longtime boyfriend, Edgar 'Egg' Ross, who has disgraced his Peace Corps family by becoming a lawyer; Miles Lawton is a charming smart guy who rejects his wealthy family background. Sam O'Donnell is the associates' mentor.
title: First Years

overview: Paul Hagen is a skilled tracker and all-around outdoorsman who prefers living in the country. Carl Palmer is a successful San Francisco lawyer who convinces Hagen that they should pool their knowledge and abilities to solve "Impossible" cases.
title: Hagen

overview: Police officer Qiao Heng came to the haunted Pinghe village during the Chinese Republican era to investigate the murder case of embroidered shoes. Qiao Heng encountered all kinds of terror and bizarre events in Pinghe village. Successive death cases introduced the truth about the past secrets of Pinghe village. What is hidden in this small village?
title: The Embroidered Shoes

overview: The action takes place in the future world of science and technology. This is the story of Fan Jian Jian, a wife who, in order to help her husband Lu Ze, who was in a car accident and fell into a coma, turned to brain expert Dr. Sun for help and took part in an experiment with a brain and a computer. With the help of technology, she penetrates into the brain of her lover, and in order to save him, she must relive three important memories for both of them.
title: Way Back Into Love

overview: Mu Si Yu is a businesslike city woman with a successful career, but an unsuccessful love experience. At a meeting organized by her ex-boyfriend, she hires Fan Zi Yin to pretend to be her boyfriend. But as a result, she falls in love with him. Later, Wu Bo Wen, another of her ex-boyfriends, joins her company. In the subtle atmosphere between her, her ex-boyfriend and her fake boyfriend, things get more interesting.
title: Well Staged Love

overview: Lai Dui Dui is a college student who dreams of becoming a successful artist. However, she has little talent or ability when it comes to other subjects and grades. Jiang Zuo, an excellent student who has no rivals when it comes to everything related to studies, studies at the same college. The two had actually crossed paths in high school before. But due to an attack of prosopagnosia (a condition in which Lai Dui Dui cannot recognize faces) she can't remember who he is. Jiang Zuo tries to avoid the attention of his ex and offers Dui Dui to pretend to be his girlfriend in return for help with his studies. Jiang Zuo used to have feelings for Lai Dui Dui, but a rival appears on the scene, and the whole idea threatens to fall apart.
title: Rock Sugar Summer

overview: Su San, a witty reporter with an extraordinary sense of smell, and detective police chief Luo Yin team up to solve a serial murder case in Shencheng; fighting to protect the people, social justice, and each other.
title: On the Scent

overview: Some long-standing personal and professional feuds are settled in one-round, one-dish winner-takes-all heavyweight battles. In each episode, Darnell stages two different battles between chefs who have beefs with each other to finally bury the hatchet and win $10,000 cash, a prized knife from the losing chef and lifelong bragging rights over their food foe. From food competition rivalries and business partner squabbles to mentor vs. protégé grudges, sparks fly in and out of the kitchen.
title: Superchef Grudge Match

overview: Every episode, one of the world's foremost survival experts is kidnapped, blindfolded, and dropped into one of the harshest environments on earth. The goal: find civilization within 100 hours. But to win this game, you don't just have to survive -- you have to do so in style.
title: Dude, You're Screwed

overview: Patrick Huard invites 10 comedians to this unique experience that borders on torture. They will spend six hours together in an enclosed space where it is forbidden to laugh. The last one to laugh will win the contest, as well as $100,000 for the foundation of their choice.
title: LOL: Qui rira le dernier?

overview: Chef José Andrés and his three American-raised daughters, Carlota, Inés, and Lucía Andrés, travel across Spain on an epic gastronomic adventure in José Andrés and Family in Spain. Diving deep into the country's delicious food culture, they visit incredible locations to discover the culinary secrets and traditions of José's homeland.
title: José Andrés and Family in Spain

overview: Contestants from across Latin America put their cultural spin on classic dishes prepared by internationally acclaimed chefs, hoping to win the $10,000 prize that goes to the cook with the best fusion.
title: ¡Qué Delicioso!
Jian Wang 3 Wan Hua Xiao Yi Xian

overview: Adapted from the web novel "Niang Zi Zai Shang, Fu Jun Bie Nao" (娘子在上，夫君别闹) by Xiao Zhong Gu Niang (小钟姑娘). University student Wu Wanwan has accidentally time travelled to a school in ancient times and disguises herself as a man in order to blend in. It follows a series of hilarious stories between Wu Wanwan andd her classmates Tang Wenqi and Qi Shan. Together, they not only fight against inequality over family status but also work towards recruiting female students in a story about integrating modern education concepts into ancient academies.
title: Guyuan Imperial College

overview: Sitcom focusing on international aid charity HELP and its less-than-charitable, egotistical managing director, Graham Templeton.
title: Mr Charity

overview: Features Darren Boyd and Cavan Clerkin, a pair of dysfunctional half-brothers are forced to explore their recurring sibling rivalries.
title: Los Dos Bros

overview: Blake Harrison and George Webster star in this comedy drama that sees them inadvertently thrown into a parallel universe.
title: Tripped

overview: In France, one day in 1980, the Parisian mechanic Jean-Louis Brozec was the victim of a motorcycle accident. At the same time, in Germany, Renate Matiessen, daughter of a billionaire, died after falling from a horse. But both come back to life very quickly and end up finding themselves in Paris, even though they were previously unaware of the existence of each other.
title: Les Visiteurs

overview: Huck uses his special gifts to do good deeds, but when his secret is revealed, he winds up on a life-changing adventure.
title: Huck

overview: In the late 20th century, lives a skillful and courageous doctor named Lin Hao. Along with his passionate and easygoing boss Wu Renyao, understanding and kind nurse Wu Ruolan, they operate a medical hall at the border of Hui Zhou Town. He also forms a friendship with Zeng Fan, who just returned from studying medicine overseas; as well as He Xinxin, a straightforward girl who works at the martial arts art house. As the group of people work together to cure patients, a mysterious case surfaced which links to the death of Lin Hao's parents. Lin Hao decides to investigate the truth, and the perpetrator turns out to be none other than the father of someone he trusts...
title: Wonderful Hand

overview: David Attenborough and a team from London Zoo travel in search of exotic animals. Their aim is to capture them and bring them back to the UK for exhibit in the zoo.
title: Zoo Quest

overview: Cameras will chronicle the rich history of New York's scenic Hudson Valley region, while showcasing a modern-day design business in Small Town Potential. Life and work partners Davina Thomasula and Kristin Leitheuser, along with Kristin's dad Don Leitheuser, will help their clients find, buy and renovate unique properties that have astounding potential. Davina, a real estate agent with a flare for design, Kristin, a builder with expert construction know-how, and Don, a skilled master carpenter, aren't afraid to take on full-scale renovations that will transform small-town houses into
title: Small Town Potential

overview: In the Alps, the resort of Les Clairies celebrates the victory of its downhill champion, Boris Arnoux, darling of the country. The party is in full swing when a fire breaks out further down the valley, in a makeshift camp. A caravan burns, enclosing in its flames a poorly housed seasonal worker. This "accident" is the starting point of an investigation led by Emilie Karras, a young policeman from Lyon, originally from Les Clairies where she grew up but whom she also left 12 years ago to save herself. She is forced to stay and collaborate with Major Servoz, a disillusioned local policeman. They will discover the twists and turns of this resort swallowed up by a luxurious real estate project that divides people as much as it stares at the mountain.
title: Piste noire

overview: When Tang Chen's career was booming, he had to declare bankruptcy when he was "selled" by his girlfriend Shuo Bing. But soon he withdrew from the swamp of failure and actively devoted himself to the second venture. Sha Zhou, a good friend for many years, has an excellent writing style, but he has always been a depressed little reporter. With the persuasion of Tang Chen and the support of his wife, he was the first to join the entrepreneurial team. According to the division of labor within the team, Tang Chen and Sha Zhou worked together to find Hou Zhi, Zhu Ran, and Bai Ying, and set up a gray whale public relations company. Tang Chen used his industry acumen for many years to actively search for customers, lead his partners to overcome difficulties, help pig feed magnate Xie Liqiang to build a public image, push the furious divine comedy, and win Feida's public relations contract. However, in a confrontation with a competing company, Tang Chen discovered an unknown secret between Shuo Bing and Ye Shou Ru. With the concern of another identity, Tang Chen and Shuo Bing fell in love and killed each other, and after a few games, they finally understood Shuo Bing's seemingly ruthless choice. In the end, the two teamed up to punish Ye Shou Ru, the culprit who caused Shuo Bing's father to commit suicide, and got back together. Every member of Grey Whale PR also realized their own value.
title: In Spite of the Strong Wind

overview: The documentary series Між крапельками tells about how Ukrainian culture survived in the Soviet Union. In those dark times, a creative approach to censorship helped to circumvent and defeat it. Fortunately, not all pro-Ukrainian citizens were imprisoned in camps and mental institutions. There were many professionals who studied the rules of the game and preserved Ukrainian between drops.
title: Між крапельками

overview: The historical program Культові українці. Позначені гривнею tells about unknown stories about outstanding personalities of Ukraine. The host of the program Yelyzaveta Tsarehradska and the co-host, historian Oleksandr Alforov will tell little-known facts from the biographies of the figures depicted on the hryvnia banknotes without complicated terms.
title: Культові українці. Позначені гривнею

overview: Renowned pastry chef Ron Ben-Israel hosts this competition series in which four of America's premier pastry chefs compete in challenges, judged by Ben-Israel, that test their ability to use secret ingredients to create, based on a given inspiration, inventive desserts in a finite period of time. The winner of each challenge advances to the final test in which the last chef standing wins $10,000. Among the challenges the contestants face is using duck fat and fusilli to create a frozen treat inspired by diamonds. Chances are you won't see that dessert in your neighborhood ice cream shop anytime soon.
title: Sweet Genius

overview: Mark Thompson and Lolly Spence explore the 300-mile Ulster leg of the International Appalachian Trail, all the way from the coastal town of Larne to Donegal.
title: Walkin' Hame

overview: Klay is a young woman who is excited to graduate from the university so she can work abroad. However, she must pass her back subject, Rizal Studies, in order to graduate. Klay wakes up one morning and finds herself in the world of Jose Rizal's novel, Noli Me Tangere. She desperately tries to return to the present but she can only do so after she finishes the story and learns her lesson. She meets the lovers in the Novel, Maria Clara, and Crisostomo Ibarra. The characters teach Klay the value of history, empathy, patriotism, and love. Soon, Klay falls in love with Ibarra and decides to stay in his world in order to save the novel's characters.
title: Maria Clara at Ibarra

overview: Fang's youngest daughter Xiang Xiang has just entered the society after graduating from university. Her elder sister Fang Hong believes that "eldest sister is like a mother", and regardless of Fang's feelings, she is enthusiastically involved in her sister's work and life. The two sisters with very different personalities and concepts constantly rubbed and collided, making this originally harmonious and intimate family in the smoke of the sisters' quarrel and quarrel all day long. Father Fang Ming was in a dilemma. He spent most of his life living for his daughters, but as his daughters became more mature and independent, Fang Ming felt that he was less and less needed. So Fang Ming began to try to find a sense of existence in his daughters' minds.
title: Sisterhood

overview: Stacey meets a variety of extraordinary families in the USA, lifting the lid on more fascinating and unusual lifestyles.
title: Stacey Dooley Sleeps Over USA

overview: Adapted from the novel "Chong Tu Teng" (虫图腾) by Yan Zhi Yang (闫志洋). Pan Jun, a descendant of a famous physician from Chong Cao Medical Hall, meets the descendant hailing from the five great families from the Chong tribe. Together, they discover a trail leading to the hidden treasures of the Chong tribe. On their journey to retrieve these treasures, they undergo various adventures which leads them to discover the secrets behind these treasures dating back twenty years ago.
title: Insect Totem

overview: Six-part series about an obituarist working at a small-town newspaper, who suddenly finds herself being paid by the obituary due to cuts. When she "accidentally" kills a nasty piece of work, she discovers she might have an untapped bloodlust, and sets her sights on other unpleasant residents of the town. Her killing spree hits a potential snag when the paper hires an attractive crime correspondent.
title: Obituary

overview: Auctioneer Sybelle Thomson delves through homes in Scotland in search of items she thinks will deliver the goods at auction.
title: The Edinburgh Auction House

overview: France 2 presents Les rencontres du Papotin. This new atypical interview magazine takes up the DNA of the newspaper Le Papotin, whose editorial staff (40 to 50 young people) is made up of journalists, non-professionals, with autism spectrum disorder. In each episode, a unique personality is interviewed without filter and without a star presenter. During this meeting, the rules of the game are simple: "you can tell Papotin anything, but, above all, anything can happen!"
title: Les rencontres du Papotin

overview: Great Performances is a television series devoted to the performing arts, has been telecast on PBS since 1972. The show is produced by WNET in New York City. It is one of the longest running performing arts anthologies on television, second only to Hallmark Hall of Fame. Great Performances presents concerts, ballet, opera, an occasional documentary, and plays. The series has also won many television awards, including an Emmy Award, a Peabody Award, and an Image Award, with nods from the Directors Guild of America and the Cinema Audio Society.
title: Great Performances
This Sitcom Is... Not to Be Repeated

overview: 24Seven focused on a group of students living at Discovery House, a dorm at the Oaks Boarding School.
title: 24Seven

overview: Journalist Christine van Blokland takes you to the most intriguing places in the world, to explore the mysteries of each destination's art, architecture and hidden histories. Each episode begins with a list of Curious Questions that will be answered in the episode, such as: Why are there so many French chateaux in the Loire Valley? Is Rome's Pantheon really an ancient sun dial? Why do Viking ships look different than Venetian gondolas? And why is there a floating church off the coast of Montenegro?
title: Curious Traveler

overview: A look back at stellar career of the footballing legend and three-time World Cup winner, who passed away at the age of 82.
title: Pelé: Long Live the King

overview: Adapted from the game Zhe Keng Die De You Xi (这坑爹的XX游戏). Interning doctor Lu Ran Ran and game designer Wang Chen Yi accidentally enter the virtual reality game he designed for his sister and together they experienced the strange unfolding of events of the imaginative and mysterious world Wang Chen Yi created.
title: Catch Up My Prince

overview: The participants of the program will be amateur musicians who dream of a big stage, but are so far known only in narrow Internet circles. The authors of the show will help them turn their songs into a real "candy". Each song will get a new breath thanks to the stars who will perform them in a new arrangement right in the studio. Five nuggets and five stars will take part in each issue: experts will evaluate their performances, and the audience in the hall will choose the winner, who will receive a cash prize.
title: Конфетка

overview: Ruan Qingtian's stepmother secretly signed a contract for her to become an assistant to an aloof CEO, Ren Haoming. What's worse, this president is also a blind man with a horrible temper; what's even worse, Ruan Qingtian has a deep-rooted history with this man! Ruan Qingtian is forced to stay by Ren Haoming's side to be tortured by him! However, the gods of fate favored the kind-hearted Ruan Qingtian, and over time, Ren Haoming and her fell in love. Although, when Ren Haoming finally recovered his eyesight through surgery and looked for Ruan Qingtian to get married, Ruan Qingtian was switched by his sister Ruan Xinxin, and as a result, Ren Hao Ming and Ruan Xinxin got engaged instead. Ruan Qingtian can only secretly care for Ren Haoming, but to Ren Haoming she's but a vixen...
title: Romance with Blind Master

overview: Angel, a teen who is determined to escape her abusive guardian Teresa. Angel warms the hearts of viewers as she humbly steps up to care for her three foster sisters Sheree, Milk and Rain. Angel finds herself in the concrete jungle surrounded by animals. Diamond and Dutch attempt to show Angel the ways of the streets, but her arrogance and lack of experience gets in her way. With no money, nowhere to live and pursued by Detective Monroe, Angel's only choice is to become a beast.
title: Angel

overview: Detective Vic Mackey is the leader of an elite Strike Team unit, a group of cops effective at eliminating crime but also operating under Vic's own set of rules. But his rules sometimes cross the fine line between legal and illegal. Now the precinct has a new captain who doesn't like Vic's tactics and wants to bust him off the force - even as the captain finds himself going to Vic for help whenever the going gets rough.
title: The Shield

overview: Nathalie Lapointe, a renowned journalist from a major newspaper and a single mother of three, has her world turned upside down when she learns that her cancer is back after two years of remission.
title: Nouvelle adresse
